newsitem.title: USA: COPPER STOCKS AT US REFINERIES DOWN IN APRIL-ABMS.
newsitem.headline: COPPER STOCKS AT US REFINERIES DOWN IN APRIL-ABMS.

text.p: Refined copper stocks held by U.S. refineries in at the end of April totaled 14,800 short tons, down 19.1 percent from March, which totaled 18,300 tons, and down 24.7 percent from April 1996, which totaled 19,000 tons, according to the American Bureau of Metal Statistics.
Copper stocks held in refineries outside the U.S. totaled 304,100 tons, up 0.4 percent from March, which totaled 302,800 tons, but up 21.0 percent from April 1996, which totaled 251,300 tons.

Statistics for stocks outside of the U.S. have been revised to include Chinese inventory data, the ABMS said. March stocks were revised upward by 138,400 tons, and April 1996 figures were revised upward by 138,900 tons.

Total copper stocks, including London Metal Exchange and COMEX stocks, totaled 530,300 tons, down 5.3 percent from March, which totaled 560,000 tons, and down 15.2 percent from April 1996, which totaled 625,900 tons.
